en: Project Office Assistant | Fictional Builder D038 | **August 2024–August 2026**; office-based administrative role
zh: 项目办公室助理｜虚构建筑企业D038｜**2024年8月—2026年8月**；办公室行政岗位

en: Maintained drawing-transmittal and RFI logs for an office-refurbishment project. Used spreadsheet filters and revision codes to route current drawings to approved recipients.
zh: 为办公室翻新项目维护图纸传递及信息请求记录，使用电子表格筛选和修订编码，将最新版图纸发送给获批接收者。

en: With the site administrator, reconciled 86 transmittals against acknowledgments in **February 2026**. The review identified 13 missing acknowledgments: 10 were obtained that month and 3 remained escalated to the site administrator.
zh: **2026年2月**与现场行政员合作，依据签收确认核对86份文件传递记录。复查发现13份缺失确认，月内取得10份，其余3份仍由现场行政员跟进。

en: Recorded meeting minutes and action owners; the project manager approved minutes before circulation.
zh: 记录会议纪要及行动负责人，纪要经项目经理审批后分发。

en: Used PDF markup to flag missing drawing numbers for review without altering technical design content.
zh: 使用PDF批注标出缺失图号供审查，不修改技术设计内容。

en: Drafted an induction-pack index in **April 2026**; it had not been approved by the safety officer for operational use.
zh: **2026年4月**起草入场培训资料索引；安全专员尚未批准其投入实际使用。

en: Maintained logs for 7 subcontractor packages at the **October 2025** project peak; 2 packages remained active in **August 2026**.
zh: **2025年10月**项目高峰期维护7个分包工作包记录；**2026年8月**仍在进行的工作包为2个。
